messages:
maya: Support flagged a pattern: customers sending large embeddings (mixed dims + big payload) get a terse 413 and no guidance. SDKs just surface it. Can we add a "split-suggestion" header so clients get a sensible fallback?
aj: Yes — add a non-blocking Split-Suggestion header on 413/400 responses with a suggested split plan + rough cost/latency estimate. Example key: `X-Embed-Split`: `dims=1024,bytes=420000,units_est=6,plan=3x341,est_parallel_ms=120`.

kevin: Fine as advisory, but Dedicated tenants must opt in via admin toggle. Also make sure it never exposes per-tenant quota values or billing links. Estimates only.

maya: We need telemetry. Add metrics `embed.split_suggest.sent` and `embed.split_suggest.applied`. Tag by tenant, route, and rollout_phase. That'll let PM see SDK uptake.

sara: Proposed rollout: hosted canary at 2% first, monitor for 7 days, then 10%, then 50%. SDKs will ship an opt-in `auto_split_on_suggestion` flag. Also add a small console card showing suggestion_sent vs applied for Embeddings.

tom: Operational risk: auto-splitting multiplies ingress and backend work. Header must include `units_est` and `est_split_requests` so SDKs can decide. Also include `est_split_total_units` so apps can estimate cost delta.
aj: Header shape I suggest: `X-Embed-Split: dims=1024,bytes=420000,units_est=6,plan=3x341,est_split_requests=3,est_split_total_units=7,est_parallel_ms=120`. If the SDK does auto-split it can decide parallel vs serial by est_parallel_ms.

kevin: Add server-side opt-out per-tenant: `embed.split_suggest.enabled=false`. For Dedicated, default off. Add unit tests to assert header suppressed when flag is false.

maya: Console specific ask: add a one-line support snippet in the Agents UI: "When you see Payload Too Large, try splitting into N vectors of ~size M or enable SDK auto-splitting." Keep it copy-paste.
sara: I'll file CON ticket to add the card and two alerts: 1) adoption alert: if suggestions_sent/requests > 0.05 AND applied < 0.1 over 7d -> PM outreach; 2) ops alert: if splitter_calls > 4x baseline -> investigate autoscale/backpressure.

tom: SDK behavior guideline: default to showing a dev-visible warning; only auto-split when `auto_split_on_suggestion=true` AND `est_split_total_units <= original_units * 1.2` to avoid surprise bills. Also include a per-tenant rate cap to avoid sudden spike in requests.
aj: Implementation plan (I'll take): - wire split suggestion estimator into preflight path - emit `embed.split_suggest.sent` metric and tag rollout_phase - include fields: dims, bytes, units_est, plan, est_split_requests, est_split_total_units, est_parallel_ms - feature flag for hosted canary

kevin: I'll add Dedicated guard rails: admin toggle, audit log on changes, and ensure header doesn't reveal tenant limits. Also add integration tests for suppression.
maya: Can we version the header key like `X-Embed-Split-v1` so we can evolve shape?
aj: Good call. Use `X-Embed-Split-v1` for initial rollout.

sara: Console ticket created: CON-102 "Split-suggestion header canary + dashboard". Rollout owner: sara. Impl: aj. Review: kevin.
devx-bot: Note: devx SDKs notified. Recommend update to default error message to suggest enabling auto-split.

maya: Decision summary: 1) Add `X-Embed-Split-v1` advisory header on hosted 413s (canary -> scale). 2) Header includes dims, bytes, units_est, plan, est_split_requests, est_split_total_units, est_parallel_ms. 3) SDKs show warning by default; auto-split behind opt-in + cost guard. 4) Console metrics and alerts added. 5) Dedicated: admin opt-in only.
aj: I'll open the PR with header impl + metrics + tests today, aiming for review tomorrow.

kevin: SGTM. Ensure the metric names are exact strings and tests cover tenant opt-out.
sara: I'll schedule canary and wire alerts. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all  will update KB after canary. Closing thread.
